This Writ Petition Is Listed For Preliminary Hearing In
 'B' Group, This Day, An Order

IS MADE AS UNDER:
 -2-  NC: 2026:KHC-D:3458  WP No. 145043 of 2020 HC-KAR  ORAL ORDER Sri.Prakash N.Hosamane., counsel for the petitioner and Smt.Nandini B.Somapur., AGA for respondents 1 and 2 have appeared in person.
2.

The captioned Writ Petition is filed seeking a writ of certiorari to quash the order dated:11.06.2019 passed by respondent No.2 vide Annexure-D and to issue a mandamus directing respondent No.2 to consider representation of the petitioner dated:16.11.2019 vide Annexure-E.
3.
Counsel for the respective parties urged several contentions.
Heard the arguments and perused the papers with care.
4. Suffice it to note that there is a dispute in the matter as to whether the Kharab lands in question falls within the category of Rule 21(2)(a) or 21(2)(b) of the Rules.
The same has to be determined by the Land Acquisition Officer after holding an enquiry under Section 11 of the Land Acquisition Act.
The Land Acquisition Officer may even take assistance of the concerned Revenue Officials.
NC: 2026:KHC-D:3458 HC-KAR 5.

In view of the same, order dated:11.06.2019 passed by respondent No.2 vide Annexure-D is quashed and a mandamus is ordered directing respondent No.2 to consider the representation of the petitioner dated:16.11.2019 vide Annexure-E in accordance with law within four weeks from the receipt of certified copy of this order.
6. The Land Acquisition Officer is directed to hold an enquiry under Section 11 of the Act and to pass an award, fixing the compensation payable for the said land.

If the land Acquisition Officer is of the opinion that the lands fall within the category of Rule 21(2)(a) of the Rules, the petitioner is entitled to the compensation, inasmuch as, such lands belong to the ownership of the writ petitioner.
If the lands fall under Rule 21(2)(b) of the Rules, then such lands belong to the Government and the petitioner cannot have claim over such lands.
7. With the above observations, the Writ Petition is allowed.
